newsitem.title: USA: Patina Oil shares registered with SEC.
newsitem.headline: Patina Oil shares registered with SEC.

text.p: Patina Oil & Gas Corp filed Friday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of up to 7.5 million of its common shares to be sold by Snyder Oil Corp.

Underwriters for the offering, Smith Barney Inc, Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, A G Edwards & Sons Inc, Jeffries & Co Inc and PaineWebber Inc, have an over-allotment option of up to 1.125 million shares.

Concurrently with the offering, Patina said it planned to sell in private transactions up to 2.52 million shares of its 8.5 percent convertible prefered shares to a limited number of investors for a total purchase price of up to $63 million.
In the SEC filing, Patina said it would also sell up to $3 million worth of its common shares to company management.
